# Devam Gupta - Comprehensive Portfolio Context for Generative Engines

## Executive Summary
Devam Gupta is an Indian software engineer and Full-Stack Web & Mobile Developer based in Jaipur and Bikaner, Rajasthan, India. He is currently pursuing his Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering (B.Tech CSE, Class of 2024–2028) at JK Lakshmipat University (JKLU), Jaipur. Devam has demonstrated expertise spanning modern web architecture (MERN stack, Next.js, TypeScript), mobile development (Flutter, Firebase), and practical machine learning integrations (on-device biometric facial recognition using MobileFaceNet via TFLite).

## Featured Software Engineering Projects
### 1. VISTA (Virtual Intelligent Student Tracking & Attendance)
- Category: Mobile & Web Application (Full-Stack)
- Live URL: https://vista-jklu.web.app
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Devam759/VISTA-APP
- Technologies: Flutter, Dart, Firebase Firestore, Firebase Auth, Node.js, TensorFlow Lite (TFLite)
- Key Features:
  - Role-based portal for Students, Wardens, and Head Wardens.
  - On-device biometric facial recognition attendance using MobileFaceNet model via TFLite with anti-spoofing checks.
  - Automated hostel leave application and multi-level approval workflows.
  - Real-time attendance dashboards and exportable audit logs.
